entities.summary: Jahmir Young is an American professional basketball player for the Miami Heat of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Sioux Falls Skyforce of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Charlotte 49ers and Maryland Terrapins.
